name: Jahan Hawkwing
summary: At the Crossroads, Jahan Hawkwing keeps Horde travelers supplied with armor. The tauren armorer works from this outpost in the Barrens, where predators roam the plains.

sections.title: Armorer of the Crossroads
sections.body: Jahan Hawkwing tends to the armor needs of Horde travelers and defenders at the Crossroads. In the Barrens, durable gear can mean survival against centaur, quilboar, and wild beasts. Jahan works with local leatherworkers, sending cured hides for delivery so his shop stays stocked with dependable tanned leather and sturdy chainmail.

faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing is a tauren merchant and armorer stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He supplies passing adventurers and Horde guards with protective leather and mail equipment.
Jahan sells basic sets of tanned leather and chainmail armor, including jerkins, boots, belts, bracers, and gloves. The gear suits novice warriors, hunters, and scouts.

faq.q: What tasks does he offer to travelers?
faq.answer: Jahan depends on nearby artisans to supply his wares. He asks travelers to carry raw or prepared materials to local tanners, then waits for the finished goods to return.

angles.text: At the Crossroads, where Kalimdor's major trails meet, Jahan helps keep Horde warriors and scouts armored against centaur raids and local wildlife.
Jahan reflects the shu'halo's practical, self-reliant ways. He uses hidecraft and sturdy materials to protect travelers in the Barrens, the ancestral lands of the tauren.
